figures.caption: Fig. 1. (a) Comparison of conventional physically mixed Ag–C and PVP-assisted AgNO3-based interlayers. (b) SEM image of the Ag particles used to fabricate the Ag–C 25 interlayer. (c) Surface SEM image and corresponding Ag elemental map of the Ag–C 25 interlayer. (d) Schematic illustration of the slurry-based fabrication process for the AgNO3–C–PVP interlayer.

Fig. 2. (a) Surface SEM images, corresponding Ag elemental maps and (b) HAADF-STEM images of the AgNO3–C 25 and AgNO3–C–PVP 25 interlayers. (c) XRD patterns, (d) Raman spectra, and (e) N 1s XPS spectra of the Ag–C 25, AgNO3–C 25, and AgNO3–C–PVP 25 interlayers.

Fig. 3. (a) Simulated initial charge profiles, (b) Li nucleation rate, (c) amount of Li nuclei, and (d) creep-equivalent areal current densities for interlayers with Ag-domain sizes of 10, 50, and 100 nm. (e) Pressure-temperature contour maps of the residual Li fraction (Q_res,Li/Q_charge) calculated using the creep-based descriptor at 0.5C for Ag-domain sizes of 10, 50, and 100 nm.
Fig. 4. Cross-sectional SEM images and corresponding C and Ag elemental maps of cells employing (a) Ag–C 25, (b) AgNO3–C 25, and (c) AgNO3–C–PVP 25 interlayers after the initial charge.

Fig. 5. (a) XRD patterns after the initial charge and (b) N 1s XPS spectra after the initial charge and subsequent discharge of the Ag–C 25, AgNO3–C 25, and AgNO3–C–PVP 25 interlayers. (c) Adsorption energies of a Li adatom at the adsorption minimum and the adjacent saddle-region configuration on the Li3N (001) surface, with the corresponding atomic models, and (d) calculated diffusion-energy profiles and (e) corresponding diffusion barriers for a Li adatom on the LiC6 (0001) and Li3N (001) surfaces.

Fig. 6. (a) GITT profiles and (b) corresponding within-pulse polarizations (dE_t) of the Ag–C 25, AgNO3–C 25, and AgNO3–C–PVP 25 half-cells at 45 C. (c) Nyquist plots and (d) corresponding DRT spectra after the initial charge. (e) Initial Li-deposition profiles and (f) corresponding nucleation overpotentials and lithiation capacities. CCD measurements at (g) 60 C and (h) 45 C.

Fig. 7. (a) Schematic illustration of the operando pressure-monitoring setup and (b) simultaneously recorded stack pressure changes and voltage profiles of full cells employing Ag–C 25, AgNO3–C 25, and AgNO3–C–PVP 25 interlayers during cycling at 0.2C. (c, e) Initial charge–discharge voltage profiles at 0.1C and (d, f) long-term cycling performance at 0.2C and 45 C of full cells employing interlayers with nominal Ag contents of (c, d) 25 wt% and (e, f) 15 wt%.
Fig. 8. Schematic illustration of the proposed mechanism for the AgNO3–C–PVP interlayer.
